items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: <h1> reads "Equipment List" (singular list noun, not a plural title such as "Machines"). The header has no actions at all, so the at-most-one-primary rule is trivially met, but the title criterion is not.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Table and search are in the first viewport (firstTableTop 250) with status and area selects. But section#summary renders a row of 4 KPI tiles (Total machines 16, Fault 2, Inspections overdue 3, Due within 14 days 3) above the filters and table.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: sortKey='next' ascending by ISO date. Screenshot order: Overdue by 8 days, 3 days, 1 day, then Due in 5, 7, 13 days, then In 17 days and later.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: nextCell() prints "Overdue by N days" and "Due in N days" text under the date, with colour only as reinforcement.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: All dates go through fmt() (en-GB, "28 Oct 2026"). Each row has a monospace code EQ-1001 to EQ-1016.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: Summary tiles show "Inspections overdue 3" and "Due within 14 days 3", and "Fault 2". They are KPI tiles rather than tabs or a summary line, and the footer count only gives "Showing 16 of 16 machines". The counts are present but the form is weak.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit table-row-two-line: 16 of 16 rows are two-line (about 61px), because the next-inspection cell stacks the date and a note. There is no actions column, so no row actions exist at all.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: #empty only says "No equipment matches the current filters." There is no clear-filters button, no separate first-use empty state, no loading state and no error or retry state (data is a hard-coded array).

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit: smallTargets 0 of 9 targets; contrast 130 checked, 0 violations. Badges and notes use the 700/800 tones on 100 backgrounds.

notes: Audit score 92 with two warnings: uppercase-text on column headers (uppercase tracking-wide) and two-line rows. The page is clean on gradients, glass, emoji, hover-lift, oversized radius and sidebar. The KPI tiles have no icons or delta pills, so kpi-icon-tiles does not apply. Main failures are the KPI row above the table, a singular title, two-line rows, no row actions, and missing no-results, clear-filters, loading and error states.
